additional_local_service_review.supported: Ford identifies diagnostic/pressure-relief function and removable valve/cap, with the specified diagnostic gauge. It does not supply valve-core travel or sectional dimensions.

motion.spring: Existing four-turn geometry retained; helix height changes from1.62 to1.50 mm. Minimum illustrative pitch0.375 mm exceeds wire diameter0.36 mm by0.015 mm; no real spring rate or preload established.
motion.cap_state: Any nonzero opening requires both cap and cap seal excluded from the working state. This does not model a gauge connector or fuel collection.

flow_test: A connected chain of narrow cylindrical probes runs through the lower core inlet, around the poppet, across the opened seat and up the outlet. Each opened-state probe is also tested against the unchanged closed assembly as a blocking control. The actual installed rail branch is checked independently.
seal_limit: Existing static seal has0.01 mm radial clearance to its groove. The adapter deliberately preserves and reports this gap; connectivity through the intended seat does not establish leak-tightness or exclude bypass leakage.
integration: Replacement-state API only. Replace fuel_test_valve.build invocation with this module's build((define,add,group),travel=0,cap_removed=False) if accepted. Never add the module alongside the existing eight parts. Closed geometry and identifiers are preserved. For motion UI use components()/parts(); regenerate spring for each state and translate pin/seat together.

validation_summary.closed_build_api: Eight definitions and occurrences; existing group datum preserved.
